nodes.label: Claims register rules: a claim is Approved only with owner-supplied evidence, approver acceptance, and a review/expiry date; no page is independent evidence for another page
Legal entity claim: owner-supplied/conflict pending; only PandaCodeGen brand + info@pandacodegen.com public; MC Patches LLC d/b/a PandaCodeGen vs PandaCodeGen LLC conflict in draft SOW unresolved
Founding date/leadership: owner-approved - founded February 2026; Hassan Jamal Co-founder/Lead Engineer; Imran Raza Ladhani Co-founder/Lead Architect; mailing address 701 Tillery St Ste 12, Austin TX
Telephone and social/directory profiles: withheld; email and first-party contact form only until ownership/monitoring proof and approval exist
Primary offer and ICP: SEO-safe migrations for revenue-generating WordPress, Webflow, and GoHighLevel sites; 'SEO-safe' means continuity controls, not a ranking guarantee
Public prices and packages: Starter from $1,500, Growth from $3,500, Scale $5,000-$10,000; extras separately scoped in writing

Engagement documentation: flexible model - simple quote/order summary accepted in email/chat for straightforward work; signed SOW/master agreement/BAA for regulated or complex work; another client's SOW is not the standard template

Payment, cancellation and refunds: common default 30% onboarding/70% delivery milestone; 100% failure refund only if expressly contracted; refund initiated 2-3 business days, settlement up to 10-12 days
Warranty, support, response times: published defaults 15 business days (Starter) / 30 business days (Growth/Scale); larger bespoke projects are project-specific

Source code, IP, accounts and licenses: private proprietary repo, no OSS license; after full refund client keeps content/data/accounts but no right to unpaid/refunded custom code; PandaCodeGen retains reusable internal tools/templates
Delivery time, start date and capacity: withheld; 'timing follows discovery and is stated in the accepted proposal'

Performance and Core Web Vitals: owner-approved default 90+ Lighthouse performance target mobile+desktop per representative page, three passing pre-handover runs; not a field-CWV, ranking, or revenue guarantee
Accessibility claim: conditional - state target standard and tested scope; do not claim legal compliance or full conformance from an automated scan alone
Security and availability: conditional - describe implemented controls and limitations; forbid 'unhackable', 'zero attack surface', absolute uptime/security language
Search rankings, indexing, traffic, AEO/GEO and AI citations: no guarantee - technical work can improve crawlability/indexability/clarity but search/AI systems control inclusion and ranking
Hosting, SaaS and total cost: conditional - use dated invoices, current vendor terms, usage assumptions; a free tier is not a zero-cost guarantee
Case studies, customer names, logos, testimonials and result screenshots: withheld except the /work page's two owner-confirmed facts and the three homepage review excerpts

Source-linked public review excerpts: owner-authorized Clutch quote plus Trustpilot quotes from Marshall James and James Peace; link each to public source; do not publish reviewer portraits or aggregate ratings
Client-site credits and portfolio links: natural PandaCodeGen brand anchor with rel=nofollow, no ranking-credit promise; use 'sponsored' if classified as paid placement

MyCustomPatches and Panda Patches: owner-authorized, evidence reconciliation pending - 22-day delivery, 3.2s/45 PageSpeed to 0.7s/97 PageSpeed reported change labeled owner-reported pending dated test record; never republish customer/order-level operational screenshots
Partner and white-label services: conditional - a white-label/referral arrangement may be scoped in writing; do not imply standing capacity, SLA, confidentiality, margin, or payment terms
Public automated audit: approved with limits - 'heuristic automated technical snapshot', not a certification/pen test/ranking signal; email delivery uses opaque single-use token
Form analytics and abandonment claim: approved with limits - aggregate GA4 funnel events only after analytics consent; never typed values or PII
Cookies, vendors, retention and international processing: owner intends GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Meta Pixel, Cal.com, Tawk.to, and Vercel Web Analytics; optional vendors default-denied by category
Editorial and third-party facts claim: conditional - prefer primary sources, distinguish fact/estimate/opinion, per-article evidence ledger and review cadence tracked in EDITORIAL_FACT_CHECK.md

Owner decisions still required: verify MC Patches LLC formation/DBA, define confirmation checklist, confirm code/IP transfer timing, confirm Lighthouse test method, confirm telephone/social profiles, reconcile MyCustomPatches facts, decide partner offer status
